title: fill in the blanks
rule: When a label/control pair is awkward, present the request as a short sentence with blanks to fill in.

citation.source: Designing Interfaces 3e ch. Getting Input — Fill-in-the-Blanks (Tidwell, Brewer, Valencia)

pass_when: Awkward label/control pairs are recast as a short sentence with blanks.
fail_when: The request is an awkward disconnected label+blank where a sentence-blank would fit the cited pattern.
overview: Recast awkward label/control pairs as a short sentence with blanks.
apply_when: Label-plus-blank pairs read awkwardly as disconnected controls.
not_when: Simple named fields where a plain label already fits.
agent_hint: Rewrite awkward label/control pairs as a short sentence with blanks.
description: When a label/control pair feels awkward, present the request as a short sentence with blanks to fill in. Pass when those awkward pairs are recast that way; fail when the request stays a disconnected label-plus-blank where a sentence-blank pattern would fit. Use the sentence form to make the ask readable without inventing new requirements beyond the cited pattern.
